problem: Core $20B/$1B mechanism must be primary-source provable
evidence_or_reason: Adobe and Figma SEC filings plus merger prospectus directly establish proposed consideration reverse termination fee and actual payment
recommended_fix: Use SEC/merger documents as Stage01 spine

problem: Generic wording that regulators blocked the deal can overstate procedural posture
evidence_or_reason: Parties publicly said there was no clear path to required regulatory approvals and mutually terminated; CMA findings were provisional
recommended_fix: Use precise termination/approval wording unless later primary record supports stronger wording

problem: Figma later IPO does not by itself prove the $1B fee caused IPO success
evidence_or_reason: Chronology is documented but causation requires separate evidence
recommended_fix: Use IPO as later consequence/context without unsupported causal claim

problem: $1B could be mischaracterized as a regulator fine or breakup penalty imposed after the fact
evidence_or_reason: Signed merger agreement says fee is not a penalty but liquidated damages; prospectus shows it was negotiated before signing
recommended_fix: Lock contractual termination fee/liquidated damages wording

problem: CMA published provisional findings and possible remedies but no final prohibition because parties abandoned transaction
evidence_or_reason: CMA case page records Phase 2 cancellation after abandonment
recommended_fix: Use provisional findings / possible remedies / cancelled inquiry language

problem: Statement of Objections may be mistaken for final decision
evidence_or_reason: Official DG COMP post-case brief states SO was preliminary and abandonment ended investigation without formal decision
recommended_fix: Use preliminary concerns; no formal final EC decision

problem: Secondary narratives may imply DOJ filed suit
evidence_or_reason: Official DOJ source confirms investigation and post-abandonment statement but no public complaint identified in Stage01
recommended_fix: Do not claim DOJ lawsuit absent later primary filing

problem: Proposed purchase price could be confused with actual payment
evidence_or_reason: SEC/Adobe sources distinguish proposed ~$20B consideration from actual $1B termination payment
recommended_fix: Keep figures in separate visual/narrative tracks

problem: Figma later IPO is tempting to attribute to termination fee
evidence_or_reason: Primary sources establish chronology but not causal relationship
recommended_fix: Use IPO as independent-company epilogue only
